d:
The Wizards defeated the Magic, 103-94 tonight in Orlando. Anthony Davis contributed a team-high 27 points to go with 9 rebounds and 4 steals, with Kyshawn George of the Wizards adding an additional 22 points (9-15 FG, 4-8 3P) in the game. Franz Wagner finished with a team-high 24 points along with 6 assists for the Magic in the losing effort. The Wizards improve their record to 4-3 with the win, while the Magic fall to 2-5 for the season.
